What Does The Name Jofrey Mean?
s: In medieval England, Geoffrey was popular through Norman influence after 1066; modern respellings like Jeffery/Jeffrey and creative forms like Jofrey/Joffrey reflect phonetic spelling trends and pop-cultural reinforcement. Common diminutives and nicknames include Jof, Joff, Joe, Jo, Jeff, Jeffy, and in French contexts Jo or Jof’. Related feminine forms include Geoffrine (rare) and Godofreda (historical).
